## Contract review

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `254394d46f57cf3989c169d107c5d1f6d04061bb`
Local-runs: none
Scope: ui/packages/components/src/ui/index.ts + ui/packages/components/src/ui/dialog.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/ui/dropdown-menu.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/ui/sheet.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/ui/sidebar.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/custom/mobile-dialog-content.tsx, ui/packages/components/src/index.ts

Rendered 2026-11-08T01:23Z on card #25921 (batch 14: claim 6714776657, amendment 6714859776), face narrowing. Inputs: the card body and all 133 comments, PR #31318's body, file list and net diff against `main` (merge-base `7c523aa1`, `origin/main` `57675a21` at review time), and the head's check-runs. Nothing from the dispatch order was read.

### ① Derived judgments

- **Accept set.** The diff changes one code file, the unpublished sub-barrel `ui/packages/components/src/ui/index.ts`, which `src/index.ts` star-exports as the whole shadcn layer (`export * from './ui'`). Four `export *` lines (`./dialog`, `./dropdown-menu`, `./sheet`, `./sidebar`) become named lists. Judged right: the published entry of `@object-ui/components` (`exports["."]`, the only JS subpath besides `./style.css`) stops naming exactly ten values; nothing else in the accept set moves.
- **Exactly ten, none else.** Read against the four module files on `origin/main` (byte-identical to the merge-base, blobs `90d770ad`, `233df367`, `a81015bc`, `15cca610`): the module export blocks minus the head's named lists are precisely `DialogClose`, `DialogOverlay`, `DialogPortal`; `DropdownMenuPortal`; `SheetClose`, `SheetPortal`; `SidebarGroupAction`, `SidebarMenuBadge`, `SidebarMenuSkeleton`, `SidebarSeparator`. No phantom name (a name in a list that the module does not export) and no unintended drop; the four modules declare no `export type`/`export const`/`export *` outside their export block, so no type leaves by accident. Judged right.
- **Consumer census, re-run by the reviewer.** `git grep -w` per name on `origin/main` `57675a21` over the whole tree: every hit outside `ui/packages/components/src/ui/*.tsx` is one of (a) the upstream snapshots `ui/scripts/__tests__/fixtures/shadcn-registry/{dialog,dropdown-menu,sheet,sidebar}.registry.txt`, which declare their own copies; (b) for `DialogPortal`, a comment in `ui/e2e/console-boot-indicator.spec.ts` that reads "A Radix `DialogPortal`" (prose about Radix, no import); (c) for `DialogPortal` and `DialogOverlay`, `src/custom/mobile-dialog-content.tsx`, whose import reads `from '../ui/dialog'`, the module path, not the sub-barrel. Every in-package import that goes through the sub-barrel (`from '../ui'`, `'../../ui'`, `'../../../ui'`: `SidebarProvider`, `DropdownMenu*` trigger/content, `Button`, `Tooltip*`, `Popover*` and the rest) names none of the ten. No package re-exports `@object-ui/components` wholesale (`export * from '@object-ui/components'` has zero hits), so no second barrel carries the ten onward. Judged right.
- **hotcrm.** `origin/main` `6961ab13` (the census's own rev): zero hits for all ten. Noted, not a finding: hotcrm has zero imports of `@object-ui/components` at all, so its zero is vacuous rather than a positive control; the in-repo Console is the only live consumer measured.
- **No baseline or generated surface goes stale.** No api-surface/export-origins snapshot exists under `ui/`; the gate `check-unreferenced-sources.test.ts` reads the sub-barrel only for `from './toast'` / `from './sonner'`; `check-governed-queue-guard.mjs` names `packages/spec/src/ui/index.ts`, a different file; the components README names none of the ten (`check:published-readme-exports` therefore has nothing to disagree with); `ui/scripts/shadcn-sync.js` never writes `index.ts`, so `pnpm shadcn:update` cannot re-widen the entry. Judged right.
- **Check-runs on the head** at 2026-11-08T01:21Z: 53 runs, 21 success, 11 skipped, 21 in progress, 0 failure. Green already: `Check Changeset`, `PR-body guards`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Dogfood Regression Gate`, `Type Check · workspace`, `Type Check · debt ledger`, `Test Core`, `Build UI Deps`. Still running: `Type Check UI`, `Type Check · consumer gates`, `Type Check · source gates`, `Lint UI`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, the 16 `Test UI` shards, `Build & E2E UI`, `Live E2E UI`. `Type Check · consumer gates` is the one that would contradict the census above (a Console import of a retired name through the entry); the reviewer's grep found no such import, so the verdict does not wait on it.

### ② Semver level

- Changeset `.changeset/25921-components-shadcn-subparts.md`: `'@object-ui/components': patch`, title `refactor(components)!: …`, a **BREAKING** paragraph, both line-initial declarations (`Clause-②: no (narrowing)`, `Metadata-protocol: none`), one ADR-0087 marker `not-required (runtime-export-retired …)` naming all ten operands as `@object-ui/components#Name`, and a FROM/TO block whose FROM spans cover exactly the ten (grouped lines, each operand its own code span, the shape `readFromBlock` reads; no vertical pair, no table, no bare placeholder). Matches the rule in AGENTS.md Post-Task step 3: a non-protocol change, breaking, ships `patch` and keeps its BREAKING banner and ADR-0087 disposition; it matches the merged batch-6 precedent `.changeset/25921-components-zero-consumer-exports.md` line for line in shape. Judged right.
- **Clause-②:** `no (narrowing)` on both the PR body and the changeset body, line-initial. Right: an export leaves the published entry; no author-writable spec surface changes (`Metadata-protocol: none` is right, since none of the ten is a schema node type, key or value; the node types `dialog`, `sheet`, `dropdown-menu`, `sidebar` keep rendering through in-package module imports).
- **Migration prescriptions, read against the code they cite:** `DialogContent` does mount `DialogPortal` and `DialogOverlay` and draws a `DialogPrimitive.Close` button; `SheetContent` mounts `SheetPortal`, `SheetOverlay` (behind `hideOverlay`) and a `SheetPrimitive.Close`, and `SheetPrimitive` is `@radix-ui/react-dialog`, so "the `Close` part of `@radix-ui/react-dialog`" is the right package for both; `DropdownMenuContent` wraps `DropdownMenuPrimitive.Portal` itself; `Separator`, `Skeleton` (both still `export *`) and `SidebarMenuAction` stay on the entry. Every TO is true in the tree.

### ③ Boundary flags

- The dev report 6715517592 carries `open_questions: []`, `security_findings: none`. Its two deviations (no assignees on `pr_create`; `check:published-readme-exports` exit 3 NOT MEASURED locally) are process notes; the second is answered by CI, which builds the closure and runs the gate, and by the reviewer's read that the README names none of the ten.
- Amendment 6714859776's two rulings hold in the tree: `DrawerClose` stays exported (the `./drawer` list at the head still names it); the ten go as one block (one sub-barrel file, one changeset), no sidebar-only fallback.
- Out-of-scope carriers (`DrawerClose`, `MobileDialogContentProps`, plugin-timeline/fields module moves, react's `LazyPluginLoader` trio) are noted on the card and not touched by the diff. Nothing to escalate.
- No-Touch (ui AGENTS #7): the four `src/ui/*.tsx` module files are byte-identical at merge-base, `origin/main` and head; the sub-barrel `index.ts` is a `.ts` file outside the `*.tsx` zone and already carries the #25921 named-list convention in its header comment from earlier batches.

### ④ Design judgment

Narrowing read against the published spec on `main`. The declared capability of `@object-ui/components` (README: "A complete set of UI components, Shadcn's plus custom ones"; `content/docs/**` and `skills/**` name none of the ten) is the primitive family, not every Radix wrapper part; the entry keeps `Dialog`/`DialogTrigger`/`DialogContent` and its header, footer, title and description, the full `DropdownMenu` family minus `Portal`, `Sheet` with `SheetOverlay`/`SheetContent`, and the `Sidebar` provider, hooks and every structural part except four decorative ones. Each retired name is a part its kept sibling already mounts (`Portal`, `Overlay`, `Close` inside `*Content`) or a part whose replacement stays exported (`Separator`, `SidebarMenuAction`, `Skeleton`). The narrowing therefore takes nothing away that any consumer in either repo exercises and leaves no declared capability undeliverable: no implementation gap is being papered over at the consumer, and no spec refusal becomes real, since no schema surface names these parts. Attempts to break it: (i) a consumer composing a custom dialog from `DialogPortal` + `DialogOverlay` + `DialogPrimitive.Content` loses the entry route, but none exists in the tree, hotcrm or the docs, the changeset prescribes the Radix route, and the package declares `@radix-ui/react-dialog` and `@radix-ui/react-dropdown-menu` as dependencies; (ii) an in-package reader through the sub-barrel would break the build, but every such reader names kept parts only, and the one reader of two retired parts imports from the module path; (iii) the shadcn sync could re-widen the barrel, but the sync script does not write `index.ts`; (iv) a sub-menu host needing `DropdownMenuPortal` around `DropdownMenuSubContent` is told the Radix `Portal` part, which is what the retired name was (`DropdownMenuPrimitive.Portal`, a bare alias). No must-fix, no should-fix.
